priorityList: --- Icy Veins Annihilator Rotation ---
Cast Reap with 3 stacks of Voidfall.
Cast Voidblade before Collapsing Star or a Moment of Craving buffed Cull.
Cast Cull with 3 Voidfall stacks, or 4 Soul Fragments on the ground.. Click for Notes Only use this to gather Souls if it will not overcap your Fury.

Reap is used frequently throughout the rotation. Look to use it outside of Void Metamorphosis whenever you're at 3 stacks of Voidfall, or with a Moment of Craving buff. Inside of Void Metamorphosis, it is used on cooldown with 4 or more Soul Fragments on the ground.
For Annihilator, Voidblade is used to trigger the damage amp from Devourer's Bite. Use this ability whenever you will buff Collapsing Star and/or a Cull cast empowered by Moment of Craving.
Cast Reap / Eradicate with 3 stacks of Voidfall.
Note - Due to the Annihilator single-target build having very few cooldowns to cycle through, it has no real opening sequence. It simply opens straight into its standard rotation.
Pre-cast Consume 1 second before the pull.
Cast Reap when you can proc Voidfall.
Cast Consume until you reach 100 Fury.
Cast Void Ray.
Repeat the above until Void Metamorphosis is ready.
Cast Reap
Cast Voidblade
Cast Void Metamorphosis
Cast Void Ray
Cast Collapsing Star
Cast Cull
Watch out for your Voidfall stacks in the opener. If you reach three before your first Void Metamorphosis, make sure to Reap / Eradicate before starting your window.
Swift Erasure — grants 1% Haste per stack;
Path to Oblivion — grants 3% Movement Speed per stack;
Phase Shift — reduces damage taken by 2% per stack;
Final Hour — causes the above three bonuses to persist for 12 seconds after consuming Voidfall.
As Annihilator — You gain 3 stacks of Voidfall and refresh the cooldown of Reap.
